newsitem.title: USA: Chemtrak says names Donald Fluken CFO.
newsitem.headline: Chemtrak says names Donald Fluken CFO.

text.p: ChemTrak Inc on Wednesday said it has named Donald Fluken as vice president, finance and chief financial officer.
Fluken replaces Ed Covell, the company's current president and chief executive officer, in the CFO position. Covell retains his positions as president and chief executive.

Prior to joining ChemTrak, Fluken was vice president and CFO of Andros Inc., a leading manufacturer of gas analyzers used for medical and environmental applications. At Andros, Fluken was instrumental in leading a leveraged buyout, ChemTrak said.
